<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

MiniMax-M3 enables model-level sequence parallelism (SP) for TP + EP + MegaMoE (#64659), keeping the residual stream sharded by token across TP ranks, but only when pipeline parallelism (PP) is off. This PR keeps SP on under PP, handling stage boundaries the same way as DeepSeek-V4.1: non-last stages all-gather the token shards before returning `IntermediateTensors`, and the next stage re-shards them on entry. No other open PR enables this combination.

## Claims

- MiniMax-M3 with MegaMoE, TP > 1 and PP > 1 now runs the same SP path as PP = 1.
- PP2 and PP4 reproduce PP1's prompt logprobs exactly; GSM8K matches PP1 with and without DSpark.
- At PP2 × TP2, throughput is within 2.5% of the current SP-off path (decode −0.4%, mixed −2.4%, prefill +1.4%).
- PP = 1 and non-MegaMoE backends are unchanged.

## Validation

`MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` on B300, TP2 + EP + MegaMoE.

**Prompt logprobs.** Six fixed prompts via `/v1/completions` with `prompt_logprobs: 0` (405 scored positions). PP2 and PP4 with this PR match PP1 at every position (max |Δ| = 0).

**GSM8K** (1319 questions, chat, thinking disabled):

| Config | main | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| PP1 × TP2 (SP on) | 0.958 | unchanged |
| PP2 × TP2 | 0.957 (SP off) | 0.960 |
| PP1 × TP2 + DSpark (SP on) | 0.957 | unchanged |
| PP2 × TP2 + DSpark | 0.962 (SP off) | 0.951, 0.957 |

DSpark draft acceptance (`num_speculative_tokens=7`): 0.524 at PP1; 0.521 and 0.523 at PP2 with this PR; 0.526 at PP2 on main.

**Throughput**, PP2 × TP2, two interleaved runs per arm. Each cell: output tok/s of both runs / mean TPOT (ms).

| Workload (in/out, concurrency) | main (SP off) | This PR (SP on) | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| decode 512/512, c64 | 2013.3, 2004.5 / 30.06, 30.05 | 2007.4, 1993.9 / 30.18, 30.29 | −0.4% |
| mixed 2048/256, c64 | 1654.2, 1659.6 / 35.53, 34.69 | 1575.5, 1659.4 / 36.99, 35.09 | −2.4% |
| prefill 8192/16, c8 | 97.58, 98.04 / 39.67, 37.71 | 97.79, 100.50 / 39.25, 37.92 | +1.4% |

<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>

```bash
vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 16384 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --max-num-seqs 64 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching --enable-expert-parallel --moe-backend deep_gemm_mega_moe \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 --pipeline-parallel-size 2
# DSpark rows add:
#   --speculative-config '{"method": "dspark", "num_speculative_tokens": 7, "attention_backend": "FLASHINFER_TS", "kv_cache_dtype": "fp8", "draft_sample_method": "probabilistic", "rejection_sample_method": "block"}'

python tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py --port 8000 --max-concurrency 64 \
  --use-chat-completions --max-tokens 1024 \
  --chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'

vllm bench serve --model MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 512 --random-output-len 512 --num-prompts 512 \
  --max-concurrency 64 --ignore-eos --seed 1

curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "...", "prompt": "...", "max_tokens": 1, "temperature": 0, "prompt_logprobs": 0}'
```
</details>

## Details

PP transport sends 1/TP of each `IntermediateTensors` entry from every TP rank and all-gathers it on the receiver, so stage outputs must cover all tokens and be identical across TP ranks. The change:

- Drop `pipeline_parallel_size == 1` from `_use_sequence_parallel`.
- On entry to a non-first stage, shard the received `residual` together with `hidden_states`.
- At a non-last stage exit, pack `hidden_states`, `residual` and the aux hidden states into one tensor and all-gather it once. On the last rank, aux states received from earlier stages are already full and are appended after the local gather, as before.
- Build the dense MLP's `down_proj` with `reduce_results=False` under SP. With PP > 1 the decoder layer asks each FFN to reduce its own output, but under SP the dense MLP already reduce-scatters the `down_proj` output, so an extra all-reduce would sum it twice.

AI assistance (Claude) was used to investigate, implement and validate this change. The submitter reviewed every changed line and the validation results.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

     parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
     return (
-        parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size == 1
-        and parallel_config.enable_expert_parallel
+        parallel_config.enable_expert_parallel
         and parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size > 1
     )
 
@@ -449,7 +448,8 @@ def __init__(

             bias=False,
             quant_config=quant_config,
-            reduce_results=reduce_results,
+            # Under SP the forward reduce-scatters the output itself.
+            reduce_results=reduce_results and not use_sequence_parallel,
             disable_tp=disable_tp,
             prefix=f"{prefix}.down_proj",
         )
@@ -1609,6 +1609,8 @@ def forward(
                     hidden_states,
                 )
             hidden_states = sp_shard(hidden_states)
+            if residual is not None:
+                residual = sp_shard(residual)
 
         remote_aux = self.collect_remote_aux_hidden_states(intermediate_tensors)
 
@@ -1637,6 +1639,14 @@ def forward(
             self._maybe_add_hidden_state(
                 aux_hidden_states, self.end_layer, hidden_states, residual
             )
+            if self.use_sequence_parallel:
+                # PP transport expects tensors replicated across TP ranks.
+                hidden_size = hidden_states.shape[-1]
